import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data: np.ndarray) -> plt.Axes:
    """
    Plot the cumulative probability distribution of the input data sorted by value.
    """
    try:
        arr = np.asarray(data, dtype=float).ravel()
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise TypeError("Input array contains non-numeric inputs.") from exc

    if np.isnan(arr).any():
        raise ValueError("Input array contains NaNs.")
    if np.any(arr < 0):
        raise ValueError("Input array contains negative numbers.")

    sorted_data = np.sort(arr)
    x = np.arange(sorted_data.size)

    if sorted_data.size == 0 or np.all(sorted_data == 0):
        cumulative_prob = np.zeros_like(sorted_data, dtype=float)
    else:
        total = sorted_data.sum()
        cumulative_prob = np.cumsum(sorted_data, dtype=float) / total

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(x, cumulative_prob, marker="o", linestyle="-")
    ax.set_title("Cumulative Probability Plot")
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative Probability")
    return ax
